value.answer: No single winner, but the Toyota Sienna is the one I'd pick for most families. Edmunds ranks it first, it gets 35-36 mpg with a standard hybrid, and it's available with AWD. If you want the most cargo room, the Kia Carnival has the edge, and U.S. News likes the Honda Odyssey best. Going by what I found as of today, anyway. Tell me your budget and whether you need AWD and I can narrow it down.
